state:
Goal `core-queue-stats`: `attempts`, `claimed` and `deadAttempts` of `Core\Queue\Stats` are finished. Their figures are in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.
`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Queue\Stats'` still owes all of `pending` and `deadLettered`. Those two are the last members of the goal.
Shared fixtures: `benches/members/core/Queue-Stats/nvs.toml` serves every bench of the class. An example or an attack needs its own copy of `docs/examples/core/Queue-Stats/attempts/nvs.toml` in its member directory.
The Rust half goes in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/queue_sqlite.rs` after `sqlite_dead_attempts_sum_the_buried_rows_of_one_queue_and_nothing_live`. It reads its column with `counts(&reader)[i]` in the order pending, claimed, attempts, deadLettered, deadAttempts. `dead_letter(conn, id, lease)` needs the lease to equal the row's `claimed_at`.
A new bench is measured with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<id>'`. Until then the gate reports `perf: stale`.
The `claimed` card said a stopped worker's job "returns to `Pending`". The count is `state = 1` and ignores `claimed_at`, so the card now says the job stays claimed until another worker takes it after `[queue] visibility`.
